scale.label: Band density
scale.description: How many color bands fit across the word: at 1 about three, higher packs them tighter

driftPhase.label: Drift
driftPhase.description: Slow lean of the fronts, from tilted one way to the other (0-1 cycle position)

time.label: Time
time.description: Seconds from the scope's time product: the bands scroll, they do not wrap

frontWidth.label: Front width
frontWidth.description: How much of each band the change to the next color takes: small is a crisp edge, large a soft blend
